UFO Moviez India Ltd 
 
Q2&H1FY27 Conference Call 
On Wednesday, November 4 @ 12:00 noon IST 
 
Mumbai, 30 October 2026: UFO Moviez, India’s largest in-cinema advertising platform, with the power to 
impact almost 1.8 billion viewers annually through 3946 screens with Multiplex and Single Screens across 
1330 cities & towns, will host a conference call for investors and analysts on Wednesday, November 4, 
2026 at 12:00 noon IST to discuss the Company’s Q2&H1FY27 financial results which will be announced 
on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

You are cordially invited
